title: 8 Habits a Godly Man Refuses to Let Live
caption:
Scripture doesn't say manage your sin. It says put it to death. Save this and go through it slow. Not every line will land the same day, but one of them is yours right now. Pick the one that stung and take it to a brother this week, not just to your journal.

A godly man isn't the guy with no habits left to kill. He's just the guy who stopped negotiating with them.
